title: The lane brief says the owner never reads the lane, and routes each override, owner act and question to the coordinator
why: Owner 13:26 CST Nov 12: "does anything in the briefs you spawn let lanes know that i won't be checking them and so if they need an override etc to let you know so you bring it to my attention?"
note: Home: decision questions-go-to-owner. Measured: skills/project-ops/templates/brief.md on main 2deb827ad has no such line, and no archive line. Fix: the brief template says the owner never reads the lane; each override line, owner act and question goes to the coordinator, which brings it to the page as an owner act naming the lane by role and step; a check refuses a brief without the line. Red first. The archive line rides step handoff-lands-tracked-first (lane archive-flow, running). Meanwhile the coordinator carries the line in briefs by hand.
